combos.title: Combos
combos.subtitle: Manage product combinations
combos.pageHelp: A combo has no price or GST rate of its own. Its MRP is added up from the pack sizes you put in it, and each item is taxed at its own rate — so you only ever type the selling price. Change what's inside and the MRP moves with it.
combos.mrpHint: Sum of the component sizes below. To change it, change the components.
combos.sellingPriceHint: What the bundle actually sells for. Leave blank to sell at MRP.
combos.lowStockHint: Email the admin when the number of combos that can still be built (limited by the scarcest product in it) drops to this or below.
combos.productMissingHint: This product no longer exists. Please select a different product or remove this item.
combos.noActiveSize: This product has no active size and cannot be added to a combo.
combos.noProductsAdded: No products added. Click "Add Product" to add products to this combo.
combos.comboMrpHint: The sum of these component sizes — this IS the combo's MRP. GST is charged per component at its own product's rate.
combos.homepageSectionsHint: Choose which homepage sections this combo appears in.
combos.noSections: No sections defined yet. Create sections in the Django admin first.
combos.needOneProduct: Please add at least one product to the combo
combos.priceAboveMrp: Selling price cannot exceed the MRP of ₹{{mrp}}.
